claim_boundary: One task-owned physical GPU 0 isolated engineering candidate only. The five-GPU resident production gate, physical acoustic path, perceptual quality, and deployment are NOT_RUN.
duration_rule: The new-work window is 1800 seconds. A shorter explicit diagnostic duration may produce FAIL evidence but may never produce ISOLATED_PASS.

topology.lease_rule: At most one output-stage process is resident. A stage is never stopped while its lease count is nonzero. Different output-stage process lifetimes and leases must not overlap.
topology.realtime_queue_contract: Existing server session, VAD, response, playback-ACK, and bounded-queue behavior; no policy changes.

warmup_before_baseline.rule: Populate fixed ASR/VLM/server workspaces before the pre-measurement baseline. Warmup requests remain raw evidence and are never substituted for any measured fault or modality gate.

required_real_coverage.text_code: Repeated real streamed Qwen3.8 text/code answers.
required_real_coverage.interleaved_visual: Real FLUX image, native Wan video, and streamed native TTS in public narrative requests.
required_real_coverage.full_duplex_voice: Real ASR -> Qwen3.8 -> native TTS over raw WebSocket, server VAD, second-utterance barge-in, digital timed playback before ACK, and at least one actual delayed-socket-read window.
required_real_coverage.natural_video_input: Caller-frozen real natural video through public video_url and Qwen3.8.
required_real_coverage.abort_retry: Seeded real /abort after public output begins, followed by a valid same-lane retry.
required_real_coverage.malformed_recovery: Both corrupt audio and invalid video dimensions, each followed by a successful real valid request.

resource_method.device_growth: Final same-residency GPU 0 used MiB minus the post-warmup, pre-measurement ASR+VLM baseline; output load/unload oscillation is excluded by identical residency, not called a leak.
resource_method.rss_growth: Final same-residency summed server+ASR+VLM RSS MiB minus the same processes' pre-traffic baseline.
resource_method.latency: Nearest-rank p95 over every measured high-level request/response latency, including cancellations, expected faults, failures, and outliers.
resource_method.nvml_pid_namespaces: NVML host-namespace PIDs are never equated to container subprocess PIDs. Stable samples must contain exactly the two base processes plus at most one leased output process; any excess stable sample, unknown residency, owned-process crash, process-lifetime overlap, or non-idle cleanup fails. Explicit stop/start transition rows remain raw but are not a stable topology.

raw_evidence_rule: Retain every request, event, failure, outlier, raw transport byte, media artifact, native tap, log, process identity, and resource sample in the caller-selected external evidence directory. No rolling deletion or per-file truncation is permitted. SHA256SUMS covers every regular evidence file except itself.
